shared_elements: carved stone monument, upright with rounded top
low-relief carving on a single face
symmetrical winged or outspread element near the top
justification: Both are upright, round-topped stone monuments bearing relief carving with a prominent circular disc and a horizontal dividing band, and both have a symmetrical spreading motif in the upper zone. But A organises small, finely incised figures and sign-like elements into stacked horizontal registers on pale, smooth stone, while B is a massive, deeply modelled dark-stone sculpture whose carving follows a single anthropomorphic body rather than any register scheme.
